newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning after Dow falls.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning after Dow falls.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped in early morning trade on Wednedsay, discouraged by a slide in Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
But they also said investor demand below 20,500 was likely to inhibit declines.
The key Nikkei 225 average dropped 101.01 points or 0.49 percent to 20,529.55 at 0017 GMT. Its December futures were 90 points lower at 20,570.
On Tuesday, the Dow Industrials lost 80 points or 1.21 percent to about 6,443, its biggest point loss since mid-July.
